scope: All post-White KBNvK placements; continue through support changes; all preferred White ties and every legal Black reply; no return-history filtering.

method.classification: Exact White K/B/N squares modulo the eight D4 board symmetries, without translations; Black square varies. Groups form a disjoint partition of positions. Larger minor-pair groups are a separate coarser partition, not competing motif sizes.
method.cycleDefinition: Direct membership on cycles; no loop-reachability counts. White: all preferred ties. Black: every legal reply. Continue through support changes.

lossTarget.description: Five-diagonal bishop on b5 or d7; king on d6 or c5, adjacent to c6; knight on b4 or e3, approaching a seven-support square. Preferred Bc6 loses support.
